run_gtest_fail_if_no_test_linked_tests: run the googletest fail-if-no-test-linked test suite to verify flag behavior with gtest_test_utils.Main
test_gtest_fail_if_no_test_linked_flag: test the gtest_fail_if_no_test_linked flag by running executables with and without the flag via GTestFailIfNoTestLinkedTest.Run
test_warning_file_output_for_no_linked_t: test that a warning file is written when no tests are linked and TEST_WARNINGS_OUTPUT_FILE env var is set
test_gtest_executable_with_flag_and_env: test a gtest executable by passing a command line flag and environment variables through the Run method
verify_gtest_fail_if_no_test_linked_with: verify that disabled linked tests succeed with the fail-if-no-test-linked flag specified
